pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: The change does what the PR says. It is a bug fix with one reasonable design, so it needs no spec.
No spec file in this change.
New tests cover %, _ and backslash. Each would fail without the escaping: `?q=%25` would list every item, and `?q=_` would match any title. I could not run them because vitest is not installed here.
README only says `?q=` searches titles. That is still accurate.
The escape regex covers \, % and _ with a matching ESCAPE '\\' clause. The query is still parameterised, and the empty-q path is unchanged.
No injection: the query stays bound, and the escaping only changes the LIKE pattern. The q value is still HTML-escaped.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: the ESCAPE clause, the new test, and no tests deleted or loosened. The 'five items' count matches 3 seeded plus 2 inserted.
